review.eventDescription: One Hostelworld guest review: 0-100 score with seven sub-ratings, the text, the hostel's reply, group type, age band, trip types, nickname and nationality (row keys review_id, rating, sub_ratings, text, owner_comment, group_type, age_group, trip_types, reviewer_nickname, reviewer_country, review_date): $4 per 1,000 reviews. Not charged: reviews removed by minRating, maxRating, groupTypes, sinceDate or requireText, duplicate targets, hostels with no reviews, unknown ids, hostel rows, status rows. No start fee; proxy and compute are included in the event price. Hostelworld pages 50 reviews at a time and a busy hostel has a few thousand: maxReviewsPerProperty caps the rows per hostel. The run stops at the maximum cost per run you set (Apify run option maxTotalChargeUsd), never above it.
